Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "for the northside volunteer transport rota this week the library has asked us to cover a thursday appointment run for three residents the first pickup is mrs ellis at 8:10 from cedar court and she needs a folded walker secured in the rear compartment joel can take that leg if his car seat is moved before he leaves the depot the second ride is mr patel from birch house at 9:00 he has confirmed that he can wait inside the main entrance if the clinic is running late the last pickup is ms green at 10:20 on willow lane and she needs an extra five minutes to reach the curb because the path is uneven please send the updated driver sheet to amaya not bram and include joel's mobile number only on the copy for the drivers the fuel card is in the blue envelope beside the rota binder and the van keys should be returned to the lockbox after the final dropoff if anyone cannot cover a time slot tell me before wednesday at noon so i can ask the backup volunteers do not promise a return ride for ms green because her appointment time has not been confirmed yet", "output": "For the Northside volunteer transport rota this week, the library has asked us to cover a Thursday appointment run for three residents. The first pickup is Mrs. Ellis at 8:10 from Cedar Court, and she needs a folded walker secured in the rear compartment. Joel can take that leg if his car seat is moved before he leaves the depot. The second ride is Mr. Patel from Birch House at 9:00. He has confirmed that he can wait inside the main entrance if the clinic is running late. The last pickup is Ms. Green at 10:20 on Willow Lane, and she needs an extra five minutes to reach the curb because the path is uneven. Please send the updated driver sheet to Amaya, not Bram, and include Joel's mobile number only on the copy for the drivers. The fuel card is in the blue envelope beside the rota binder, and the van keys should be returned to the lockbox after the final dropoff. If anyone cannot cover a time slot, tell me before Wednesday at noon so I can ask the backup volunteers. Do not promise a return ride for Ms. Green because her appointment time has not been confirmed yet."}]
